subject: [PATCH 16/22] tty/sysrq: use common memory for the manual OOM zonelist

2026-11-14.patch_summary: This patch modifies the manual OOM (Out-Of-Memory) zonelist in the sysrq driver to use common memory instead of every node that has memory. This change ensures that the fallback domain for ordinary allocations contains only common memory, which is a more accurate representation of the system's available resources. The behavior remains unchanged because all nodes are considered common at this point.
